content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm curious if it's possible to send a digital value using INSYS GSM to the [product_name] PLC. My goal is to send a setpoint to the PLC—for instance, comparing the setpoint with the actual temperature from a thermocouple and then activating devices as needed. Best regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], From what I know, transmitting a value via SMS from an INSYS modem to the [product_name] PLC isn't feasible. However, you can configure the INSYS modem to activate outputs based on received SMS, and in the [product_name] PLC, use the analog multiplexer to select different values for comparison instructions, depending on the INSYS modem's outputs. Hope this assists you. Regards, [user_name]
Hello, Thanks for your reply and assistance. Could you provide more detailed explanation? I'm new to [product_name]. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to connect external communication using GSM and a [product_name] PLC to enable remote configuration of operating parameters. The discussion highlights that direct digital value transmission isn't supported, with alternative approaches relying on hardware output manipulation and PLC logic. Newcomers may find the lack of detailed implementation guidance challenging.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate being able to remotely set digital parameters on the PLC through SMS or GSM modem integration, enabling processing and control from a distance.
